rationale: Ground truth here is essentially trivial (a maintainer asked for a separate PR on an unrelated VoxCPM2 regression and approved) — neither candidate covers that, so recall is near-zero for both. Candidate X's grounded findings are undercut by a fabricated/incorrect claim (asserting the PR description says 'no test references the deploy-level seed' contradicts a test, when in fact Y shows this framing is closer to correct — X's own quoted 'contradiction' rests on describing test_serving_speech.py:3614 as disproving a claim that isn't actually false), and it spends significant space on a speculative WER/CI gating concern it admits it cannot verify, weakening precision. Candidate Y's analysis of the propagation/consumption mechanism is concise, accurate, and its two inline comments (guard comment for seed re-add, noting stage 1's removal was inert) are correct, grounded, and actionable. Y is tighter, more accurate, and equally actionable, so it wins on precision despite similar (near-zero) recall against the actual ground truth.
